files.description: Per-file indexing status (e.g. INDEXING, INDEXED). Verified live v68.

ExpressContextStatusResponse.description: Richer indexing status from GET /aec-libraries/{id}/status. Returns more than /files — adds the retriever/retriever-action wiring and per-run indexing counts.

ExpressContextRetrieverDetail.description:
Types for the Agentforce Express Context (AEC) Connect API.

AEC is a realtime BM25 index/retrieval service that bypasses the Data Cloud DLO/DMO/SearchIndex pipeline used by Agentforce Data Libraries (ADL). Because of that, AEC libraries are lighter-weight than ADL libraries: there is no data-space scope, no downstream DMO/SearchIndex assets, and indexing is (near-)realtime rather than a multi-stage provisioning pipeline.

Connect API base: /services/data/v{version}/einstein/aec-libraries

ExpressContextFileRef.description:
Metadata for a file indexed into an AEC library, from GET /aec-libraries/{id}/files.

The AEC Connect API returns file METADATA only — there is no presigned download endpoint. `filePath` is the logical SFDrive path (e.g. `$agentforce_express_context$/...`), not a fetchable URL.
